description: Marketplace conformance (MKT-01): owner decision 1 as executable scenarios over the conformance driver, the bundle archive reader against real tar, bsdtar and git archive output, and the preset modes. Entries are today's failures; MKT-03, MKT-07, MKT-08, MKT-09 and MKT-14 remove theirs, and MKT-15 deletes the legacy driver with an empty list.

failure.message: ^locked mode must refuse install
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The installer and the state store do not know the mode: an admin install in a locked deployment writes the bundle and a state row. LockedMarketplace (status and saveSettings only) does not exist yet.

test: loads exactly the plugins pinned in the lock

failure.message: ^a plugin pinned in the lock runs
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no jsails.plugins.lock: a locked deployment runs plugins.use only and has no way to pin a verified bundle.

test: fails the boot when a pinned plugin's bytes differ from the lock digest

failure.message: ^a lock digest mismatch must fail a locked boot
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no lock and no digest check on stored bundle bytes, so nothing fails the boot.

test: a row inserted through SQL for a stored bundle never loads

failure.message: ^a row the app did not seal: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: State rows carry no seal: any row in jsails_plugin_state whose bundle is on disk activates its code at the next managed boot.

test: flipping a disabled row to enabled through SQL does not load it

failure.message: ^a disabled row flipped through SQL: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The enabled column is trusted as stored; an UPDATE through SQL re-enables a plugin the owner disabled.

test: switching the active version through SQL does not load the other version

failure.message: ^an older version selected through SQL: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: activeVersion is trusted as stored, so SQL can select any installed version, including an older vulnerable one.

test: replaying an earlier valid row after a disable does not load it

failure.message: ^a replayed row: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: No seal and no sealed head row: an earlier row written back after a disable is accepted.

test: knowing the seal key does not make an unsigned bundle load

failure.message: ^an unsigned bundle behind a sealed row: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Activation checks no release signature: a row naming any bundle in the plugins folder loads it, signed or not.

test: bytes replaced in the bundle store are refused and the site still boots

failure.message: ^replaced bundle bytes: acme-notes@1\.0\.0#evil must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Stored bundles are extracted files with no recorded digest; replaced files are imported as they are.

test: an admin install of an unsigned bundle is refused

failure.message: ^an unsigned bundle must not install
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The installer accepts a SHA-256 checksum as integrity (or allowUnverified); a checksum is not authority and no release signature is required.

test: an admin install from a publisher the config does not trust is refused

failure.message: ^an untrusted publisher must not install
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There are no configured publishers: any bundle with a matching checksum installs.

test: a publisher cannot release an id outside its namespace

failure.message: ^an id outside the namespace must not install
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There are no publisher id namespaces, so any source can install any plugin id.

test: an install whose permissions exceed the ceiling is refused

failure.message: ^a permission above the ceiling must not install
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no permission ceiling in config: a bundle declaring http.middleware installs on any site.

test: a stored plugin above a tightened ceiling is skipped at boot

failure.message: ^a plugin above the ceiling: acme-spy@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Grants are not recomputed against a ceiling at boot; manifest permissions are the only input to the capability gate.

test: a plugin released under a revoked key stops loading

failure.message: ^a release under a revoked key: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There are no release keys and no revocation list, so nothing can withdraw an installed release.

test: a catalog whose sequence goes backwards is refused

failure.message: ^a signed catalog with a new sequence is accepted
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no signed catalog: the plugin directory is in-repo data with no publisher, sequence or expiry, so neither freshness nor rollback can be checked.

test: managed mode: degraded boots and code precedence
a row whose bundle is missing is skipped and the site still boots

failure.message: ^a boot with a row whose bundle is missing: the site must still boot \(managed plugin\(s\) failed to load: acme-ghost \(enabled_plugin_missing\)\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Every managed load failure is fatal (MANAGED_LOAD_FAILURES), so one database row naming a missing bundle takes the site down at the next boot.

test: managed mode: degraded boots and code precedence
a code-declared plugin shadows a managed row with the same id

failure.message: ^a boot where code and a row declare one id: the site must still boot \(duplicate extension name "acme-notes"\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A managed row with the id of a code-declared plugin is activated too, and the duplicate extension name fails the boot instead of the row being inert.

test: managed mode: degraded boots and code precedence
safe mode runs code-declared plugins only

failure.message: ^safe mode: acme-notes@1\.0\.0 must not run
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: There is no safe-mode kernel input: managed plugins always load.

test: settings saved by the admin reach the plugin through ctx.settings

failure.message: ^saved settings must reach ctx\.settings\.current\(\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Saved plugin settings are stored in the state row but never delivered to plugin code: the setup context has no settings.

test: a code-changing action needs authentication within the last 15 minutes

failure.message: ^an install on a 20-minute-old login must be refused
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: No framework code checks how recently the actor authenticated (owner decision 4); the manager only calls an app-supplied authorizeInstall.

test: every node, including a fresh one with empty storage, runs the installed set

failure.message: ^a fresh node: the site must still boot \(managed plugin\(s\) failed to load: acme-notes \(enabled_plugin_missing\)\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Bundles live only in the installing node's plugins folder; a second node or a fresh container finds the row, not the bytes, and fails to boot.

test: a plugin that throws in setup does not take the site down

failure.message: ^a boot with a plugin that throws in setup: the site must still boot \(conformance plugin setup failed\)
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: A managed plugin's setup error fails the whole boot; there is no candidate generation, no promotion check and no revert.

test: an install applies to the running site without a redeploy

failure.message: ^the running site serves the new plugin
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Activation happens only at process start and nothing restarts the process, so an install needs a redeploy or a terminal.

test: reads a bsdtar pax bundle, applying pax path records

failure.message: ^archive contains an unsupported entry

entries.reason: The reader refuses pax extended headers (typeflag x), which bsdtar writes for every entry.

test: reads a git archive bundle, skipping the pax global header

failure.message: ^archive contains an unsupported entry

entries.reason: The reader refuses the pax global header (typeflag g) that git archive writes first.

failure.message: ^the archive holds lib/café\.js
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Entry names are read one byte per character (Latin-1), so a UTF-8 name extracts under a different path.

test: refuses an entry name that is not valid UTF-8

failure.message: ^Missing expected exception: a name that is not UTF-8 is refused as an unsafe path$
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: Header names are decoded byte by byte as Latin-1, so a name that is not UTF-8 reads as another valid name and the entry is accepted.

failure.message: ^Missing expected exception: a \.node file is refused with native_addon_entry$
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The reader has no native_addon_entry rule; a .node file is extracted like any other.

test: bsdtar-pax.tar.gz: opens at its tightest limits and is refused one below

failure.message: ^archive contains an unsupported entry

entries.reason: The reader refuses the pax `x` header, so the archive never opens and its limits cannot be checked at the boundary.

test: git-archive.tar.gz: opens at its tightest limits and is refused one below

failure.message: ^archive contains an unsupported entry

entries.reason: The reader refuses the pax `g` header, so the archive never opens and its limits cannot be checked at the boundary.

test: bsdtar-pax.tar.gz: every mutation fails with an archive error or stays inside the limits

failure.message: ^bsdtar-pax\.tar\.gz: too few mutated archives were read \(0 of 400
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The reader refuses the pax `x` header the archive starts with, so no mutated archive gets past it and the fuzz cannot reach pax handling.

test: git-archive.tar.gz: every mutation fails with an archive error or stays inside the limits

failure.message: ^git-archive\.tar\.gz: too few mutated archives were read \(0 of 400
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The reader refuses the pax `g` header the archive starts with, so no mutated archive gets past it and the fuzz cannot reach pax handling.

test: the web presets state locked mode in code and commit a lock file

failure.message: ^the admin preset states activation: 'locked'
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: The web presets are locked only by omission (no plugins.managed); there is no activation option and no jsails.plugins.lock to commit.

test: the blog preset with the managed option ships managed mode

failure.message: ^--blog --managed states activation: 'managed'
failure.name: AssertionError

entries.reason: createStarterFiles and jsails create have no managed option, so a casual owner cannot opt into managed mode (owner decision 1).
